# CCMAF Skills — Documents (`ccmaf-skills-documents`)

Documents done properly: audience-first drafting and revision, editorial review with sourced fact-check flags, and Office/PDF handling routed to the dedicated format skills with versioned copies.

**Audience:** Anyone who drafts, edits or manages documents.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-documents@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.

## Skills (3)

| Skill | What it covers | Reference docs |
|---|---|---|
| [`document-authoring`](skills/document-authoring/SKILL.md) | Draft any document for an audience: brief and outline first, structure, house style, revision passes, change summaries, versioned folders. | 6 |
| [`editorial-review`](skills/editorial-review/SKILL.md) | Editorial review: proofread and consistency passes, sourced fact-check flags (never asserted), term lists, tone, tracked-change etiquette. | 6 |
| [`office-formats`](skills/office-formats/SKILL.md) | Office and PDF files in a workspace: route to Anthropic docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf skills, render-and-look checks, versioned copies, open fallback. | 4 |
